content.title: Online Image Sharpener
content.p1: Fix blurry photos and enhance fine details with our advanced Image Sharpener. This tool increases the contrast along the edges within an image, making it appear clearer and more defined.
content.p2: Whether it's a slightly out-of-focus shot or a soft-looking scan, you can bring back the crispness and clarity your image helps to stand out.

unblur.title: Fix Blur
unblur.desc: Restore slightly blurred images to be crisp and clear.

detail.title: Enhance Detail
detail.desc: Bring out textures and fine lines in your photography.

control.title: Strength Control
control.desc: Adjust the intensity of the sharpening to avoid artifacts.

how_to.title: How to Sharpen an Image
list: Adjust the 'Strength' slider to control the sharpening effect.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can it fix extremely blurry photos?
faq.a1: It can significantly improve soft focus and motion blur, but it cannot recover details that simply aren't there (like severe defocus).
faq.a2: Sharpening can sometimes increase visible noise. Use the strength slider to find the right balance.
